name: Brandon Williams
detail: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

name: Moses Moody
detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Marcus Smart
detail: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Clint Capela
detail: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

name: Steven Adams
detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

name: Aaron Nesmith
detail: Nesmith exited to the locker room in the final seconds of Friday's 106-104 win over the Knicks due to an apparent hand/wrist injury, Tony East of Forbes.com reports. He posted 18 points (7-10 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), seven rebounds and one assist in 33 minutes.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
detail: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

name: Johnny Furphy
detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Ben Sheppard
detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
detail: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
detail: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Bradley Beal
detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Jordan Miller
detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Quentin Grimes
detail: Grimes (finger) said he expects to return to action Sunday against the Suns, according to Ricardo Sandoval of Lakers on SI.

name: Austin Reaves
detail: Reaves (heel) won't undergo imaging and is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Suns, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.

name: Luka Doncic

name: Chet Holmgren
detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

name: Jalen Williams

name: Noah Penda

name: Jonathan Isaac
detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

name: Paolo Banchero
detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Izaiyah Nelson

name: LeBron James
detail: James (back) is out for Thursday's game against Toronto.

name: Dominick Barlow

name: Adem Bona

name: Ja Morant
detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.
